description: This file contains the implementation of the PSR-7 Response class in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library. It defines the Response class, which implements ResponseInterface, including handling of HTTP status codes, reason phrases, headers, and response body streams.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Implements the PSR-7 ResponseInterface, representing an HTTP response with status codes, headers, reason phrases, and body streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Response object with status code, headers, body, version, and optional reason phrase.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase of the response.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response instance with the specified status code and reason phrase.
